# Echo Loop — project context

Casual puzzle-platformer for Android and iOS, built with Kotlin Multiplatform + Compose Multiplatform.
No ads and no in-app purchases (by design). Application id / bundle id: `com.conley.echoloop` (Kotlin code and Android namespace stay `com.conley.game`).

## Game concept
- Side-view rooms. The character **only runs while the player holds** (left half of screen), always in its facing
  direction, and **turns around only when it bumps a wall** (solid tile or closed door). Tap the right half to jump.
- **END LOOP** (bottom centre) ends the current run; a **ghost** replays that run exactly and then stays where it
  ended (even mid-air). Ghosts are one-way platforms and press plates.
- Hazards: spikes, pits. Doors (`A`–`E`) are open while the plate of the same letter (`a`–`e`) is pressed.
- Physics (fixed-point ints, 60 ticks/s, in `sim/World.kt`): run 90/tick, gravity 45, jump -530 (~2.8 tiles high,
  ~1.9 tiles far), tile = 1000 units, player 600x800.

## Modules and layout
- `app/` – thin Android host (`MainActivity` calls `setGameContent()` from `shared`). Landscape-locked (`sensorLandscape`).
- `shared/` – all game code. Targets: Android library, iOS (arm64 + simulator, static framework `Shared`), and **JVM**
  (tests + level generator only).
  - `commonMain/.../sim` – `Level` (ASCII parser), `World` (simulation), `LoopSession` (loops/ghosts).
  - `commonMain/.../gen` – `Solver` (BFS over the real sim, handles ghost loops) and `PuzzleGen` (level families).
  - `commonMain/.../levels` – `LevelCatalog` (8 hand-built tutorials + generated levels) and `GeneratedLevels.kt`
    (**generated file, do not edit**).
  - `commonMain/.../` – `App.kt` (screens: Splash → Title → Who/Name → Game, Scores), `GameScreen.kt`, `Screens.kt`,
    `MoreScreens.kt`, `Graphics.kt` (all art drawn in code), `shared/Sound.kt` (sounds synthesised in code),
    `shared/KeyValueStore.kt` (+ high score table).
  - `androidMain` / `iosMain` – `PrefsStore` / `UserDefaultsStore`, `AndroidSoundPlayer` / `IosSoundPlayer`,
    `PlatformBackHandler`, `MainViewController` (iOS entry).
- `iosApp/` – Xcode project generated by **XcodeGen** from `iosApp/project.yml` (`xcodegen generate`). A build phase runs
  `./gradlew :shared:embedAndSignAppleFrameworkForXcode`. Info.plist needs `CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone`.
  App icon lives in `iosApp/iosApp/Assets.xcassets`.

## Levels (100 total)
- Levels 1–8 are hand-built tutorials (hints pause the game until tapped). Levels 9–100 are generated and each is
  proven solvable by `Solver`.
- Hidden solver hints in the level text: `*` = "park a ghost standing here", `~` = "park a ghost hovering here".
  They are ignored at runtime and are kept in the saved levels so a test can re-solve every level.
- Regenerate: `./gradlew :shared:jvmRun --args="8000 92"` (seeds per family, levels to keep). Also writes `shared/levels.txt`.
- `LevelCatalogTest` checks there are 100 well-formed, unique, solvable levels.

## Persistence / scoring
- Saved: current level (`level_v2`), run score, player name, top-10 high scores, mute flag.
- Level score = max(100, 1000 − ticks − 75·deaths). Scores are recorded on "Restart game", on finishing all levels,
  or when a *new player* replaces the current one.
- PLAY: no name → name screen; otherwise "Continue as NAME / New player".

## Useful commands
- Android: `./gradlew :app:installDebug`
- Tests: `./gradlew :shared:jvmTest :shared:iosSimulatorArm64Test`
- iOS simulator build: see `iosApp/` — `xcodebuild -project EchoLoop.xcodeproj -scheme EchoLoop -sdk iphonesimulator ...`
  (Use the **Release** scheme configuration for realistic iOS performance).

## Gotchas learned the hard way
- Compose code must be compiled in `shared` (the `app` module did not apply the Compose compiler → `NoSuchMethodError`).
- Cap per-frame catch-up in the game loop (a locked phone otherwise froze the app for ~85 s on resume).
- Avoid per-tile gradients / per-frame allocations in drawing (iOS lag). Read animation time in the draw phase only.
- Moving the project folder leaves stale absolute paths in `build/` dirs: delete `build`, `app/build`, `shared/build`,
  `.gradle/configuration-cache`, `.kotlin` after a move.
- Avoid large shell heredocs in the IDE terminal; they can wedge the session.
